title: memzero_explicit throughout — do not replace with memset
description: Every sensitive buffer (inline key in ioctl_init's op struct, gen_iv stack IV, agree okm on both success and error paths, inbuf key material, outbuf on release, key export kbuf) is zeroed with memzero_explicit rather than memset. FIPS 140-3 requires key material to be destroyed before memory is released; the compiler is permitted to elide a plain memset when the buffer goes out of scope, which memzero_explicit (a compiler barrier) prevents. A reviewer who suggests 'use memset — it is cleaner' is wrong. The current calls are correct and must not be changed.
